title: Austria Caught Between Inflation Fatigue and Reform Promises · 04 Sep
keywords: Austria, inflation, energy costs, cost of living, government reform, digital state, coalition, ECB, OeNB, Reformpartnerschaft, Austrian politics, eurozone, consumer prices, public services, bureaucracy
notes: Austria's governing coalition is navigating a dual pressure test: persistent inflation that continues to squeeze households and businesses, and an ambitious but so far unproven agenda to modernise and streamline the state. With August 2026 consumer price growth still running above the European Central Bank's two percent target, the gap between government messaging and lived experience is widening. The political stakes are high, and public patience is wearing thin.
